# From Broke To Control

From Broke To Control is a practical budgeting guide for SHS graduates preparing for university and university students. It focuses on managing allowance, tracking expenses, saving money, building financial discipline and avoiding running out of money before month-end.

## Offer
- Digital ebook + editable Excel budget workbook
- Price: GH₵65
